{{Top|canon=Imperial Sector Command}}
'''Sector Command''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]-based installation. The transmission and signal codes for the [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] assigned to [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigates]] detachable cargo bay pods were kept secure at Sector Command, allowing them to be retrieved by Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agents]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
